journey.name: SOL-332 — Registro, acceso y cuenta Android
journey.description: Physical-device journey against the deployed mobile BFF. Use isolated credentials in memory; never include credentials or tokens in reports.

actions.action: Open Solventa on the connected physical device.
Tap Crear cuenta.
Verify the registration form is displayed.
Submit the empty form.
Verify the required-name validation is displayed.
Enter an isolated name, email, password and matching confirmation using the keyboard Next actions.
Submit using the keyboard Done action.
Verify Tu cuenta está lista is displayed without opening the authenticated account.
Tap Ir a iniciar sesión.
Verify the email is prepared and the password is empty.
Enter the isolated password and submit the login.
Verify Mi cuenta displays the authenticated user.
Close the application process and open Solventa again.
Verify the same account is restored without entering credentials.
Tap Cerrar sesión.
Verify the login is displayed and protected account information is no longer visible.
Open Crear cuenta and submit the same isolated account again.
Verify the existing-email error is displayed without registering or authenticating the user.
Return to login and clear the isolated email.
Verify the application is left on the login screen without credentials.
